newsitem.title: SYRIA: Russian envoy in Syria to revive regional peace.
newsitem.headline: Russian envoy in Syria to revive regional peace.

text.p: A Russian minister arrived in Syria on Monday with "fresh ideas" to revive the stalled Middle East peace process, Russian officials said.
They said Deputy Foreign Minister Viktor Posuvalyuk would meet Syrian counterpart Ruslan Alloush to discuss how to break the current deadlock in Syrian-Israeli peace talks.
"There are fresh ideas which were developed in coordination with France during the recent visit by our foreign minister Yevgeny Primakov to Paris," one official said.
He did not give details about the initiative but added that the envoy would also visit Lebanon and Jordan "and other countries during his tour".
Russia is a co-sponsor of the Arab-Israeli peace talks which were launched in Madrid in 1991 but its role has been overshadowed by the United States.
Syria and most Arab countries have criticised the United Sattes for what they call Washington's bias towards Israel.
No talks have been held between Israel and Syria since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu took office in June. Syria condemned Netanyahu for refusing to trade occupied Arab lands for peace.
